capabilities: Convert [ ] { } keystrokes into Korean corner brackets with context-aware auto mode
Insert and renumber footnotes in order of appearance
Apply Hancom-style paragraph styles (body, quote, headings 1-6)
Export notes to HWPX with real Hangul footnote/endnote and picture objects
disambiguation: Unrelated to the HanMark community plugin for HWP import/export; this one writes and exports Korean manuscripts rather than converting HWP files.
extras: On Windows desktop, auto bracket mode starts a bundled PowerShell helper process that reads the IME Korean/English state (offline, local only); a diagnostic command is included. All commands and settings are named in Korean.
intentEvidence: This plugin is the Obsidian edition of the VS Code extension HanMark 0.15.0 by Jinseok Choi (gkman1)
motivation: The author made the Obsidian edition of the VS Code extension HanMark with the original author's permission, adapting its behavior to Obsidian's multi-device environment.
problem: Obsidian has no support for Korean manuscript conventions like corner brackets, 200-character manuscript counting, or exporting notes to Hancom Office's HWPX format with real footnote objects.

relations.evidence: This plugin is the Obsidian edition of the VS Code extension HanMark 0.15.0
Footnotes become real Hangul footnote/endnote objects (numbering, separator line and placement work as usual in Hancom Office)

summary: Korean manuscript writing toolkit: corner-bracket input, auto-renumbered footnotes, paragraph styles, manuscript count, and HWPX export with real footnotes.
